created_by: P2.0 entry sequence per v4.1 AM-13.2

scope.description: Minimal named, versioned policy artifact that the P2 Broker-mediated mock path and P2.4 safe capability authorize against.
exclusions: Real subprocess execution (P3 weld work, Weld-SUB10, Weld-SUB14)

rules.rationale: P2.3 Broker-mediated mock path requires a minimal policy to demonstrate Broker.authorize -> PEP -> mock capability -> ExecutionEvent -> EvidenceReceipt (v4 §13.3 P2.3).
P2.4 safe proving capability (v4 §13.3 P2.4): one low-risk, deterministic, Raphael-native capability. Read-only fixture inspection preferred.
Runtime observation stage (v4 §13.2 StageResult). Read-only, no execution.
Runtime PEP receipt emission (v4 §13.2 EvidenceReceipt, v4 INV-2). Every execution event has Broker decision_id.

invariants_enforced: INV-1: process/network/file primitives confined to exec/ (P2)
INV-2: every execution event has Broker decision_id (P2/P3)
INV-5: CLI -> Runtime; Runtime does not import arena (P2)
INV-7: no absolute hard-coded paths in new Runtime code (P2)

retirement.retired_at: P3 (when Scope v0 lands per v4 §14.3)
retirement.rationale: Per v4.1 AM-13.2: bootstrap-v0 is not extended or reused past P2; it is retired when Scope v0 lands.

references.v4_master_roadmap: RAPHAEL_MASTER_ROADMAP_v4_DUAL_LANE.md (not in repo; external reference document)
